text: In SPoS, validators download the most recently upvoted validation algorithm and faithfully running it unedited automatically produces the winning vote, so honest validators are rewarded; this holds on the assumption that users controlling 51% of sem token power act honestly.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Secure Proof of Stake Protocol (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125827
abstract: Faithfully running this algorithm on the block will automatically choose the correct vote to win the validation pool, rewarding honest validators, assuming users with 51% of sem token power act honestly. Honesty is defined as faithfully running the algorithm, unedited.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: users holding 51% of sem token power act honestly
honesty defined as running the forum approved algorithm unedited
